name: DEADZONE CLASSIC
desc:
The classic DEADZONE vibe, recreated independently from scratch.

Try the deathmatch version:
https://www.roblox.com/games/17772691665

DISCLAIMER:
This is not a "fixed" version of DEADZONE, this is an absolute recreation with the goal to appear indistinguishable from the old DEADZONE engine. Models of original DEADZONE buildings and cars were sourced from the developer library.

Please message me with ideas and suggestions to improve this game!

Credit and special thanks to:
"DEADZONE" by DeadzoneZackZak, for making the first deadzone.
"Deadzone Remade" by Reyne, for making an awesome deadzone sequel.
"Deadzone Redux" by ZeroDarkHades, for continuing the deadzone series after Reyne's was gone.
Thank you for your supporting this project and playing my version of DEADZONE.
Nearly all stylistic choices and gameplay mechanics in this project were heavily influenced by the games listed above.

dead zone, survival, fighting, exploring, pvp, fps, zombies
